rows.Origin:
Bred by Gordon Wilson Kirkham (United Kingdom, before 1997).
Introduced in United Kingdom by C & K Jones in 1999 as 'Special Friend'.
rows.Bloom: Pink blend. None to mild fragrance. Very double, cluster-flowered, old-fashioned, rosette bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Light green, dense foliage.

Height: 18" to 30" (45 to 75cm).
